compiled_state.title: [Skill Tool]: dso:sprint invoked via Skill tool -> 'Unknown skill: dso:sprint' error returned
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 2b7f5b1e893d5ca7e60b297cc337a49d740e71a1

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Invoking the Skill tool with skill name 'dso:sprint' should load and execute the sprint skill from plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md.

#### Actual Behavior

The Skill tool returned: "Unknown skill: dso:sprint"

The skill could not be dispatched, requiring a fallback to reading SKILL.md directly.

#### Steps to Reproduce

1. Start a new Claude Code session in this worktree
2. Invoke /sprint (or /dso:sprint)
3. The PLUGIN_DETECTED handler calls Skill tool with skill name 'dso:sprint'
4. Skill tool returns error: "Unknown skill: dso:sprint"

comments.body:
Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC)

Root cause hypothesis (from manual investigation pre-dispatch):
- All .claude/commands/*.md stubs detect plugin via 'claude plugin list | grep digital-service-orchestra'
- When PLUGIN_DETECTED, they try Skill(skill='dso:sprint'), which always fails in worktree sessions because plugin skills are not loaded in the Skill tool registry at startup in worktrees
- The fallback (read SKILL.md directly) works correctly
- Fix: add worktree detection to the bash check — [ -d .git ] is true in main repo, false in worktrees
- This would route worktree sessions directly to LOCAL_FALLBACK, skipping the wasted Skill tool call
comments.author: Test

comments.body:
Investigation RESULT (BASIC tier):

ROOT_CAUSE: The wrapper detection snippet checks only whether the DSO plugin is installed ('claude plugin list | grep digital-service-orchestra'), which returns PLUGIN_DETECTED even in worktrees, but the Skill tool resolves skills relative to the main project root (where .git is a directory) and fails in worktrees where .git is a pointer file.
confidence: high

Fix: Add '&& [ -d .git ]' to the detection snippet in all .claude/commands/*.md wrapper stubs so worktrees route directly to LOCAL_FALLBACK.
Test gap: tests/scripts/test-wrapper-detection.sh has no worktree-context test case.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fix applied: 23 .claude/commands/*.md wrappers now have '[ -d .git ]' worktree guard; tests/scripts/test-wrapper-detection.sh adds 2 behavioral tests (worktree+main-repo). All 12 tests PASS. Committed in 491333c270.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Correction (post-rebase): commit 491333c270 from this session was DROPPED during rebase onto origin/main because main commit f797f35de1 (fix(0172-f188): remove .claude/commands wrappers shadowing dso:* plugin skills) deleted all .claude/commands/*.md wrappers entirely — the more thorough resolution of the same root cause. Skill tool now resolves dso:* skills via plugin registration alone (no wrapper indirection), which is what was failing in worktree sessions. Re-closing as superseded.
